servinfo.title: Description of Blind Spot Monitor System Components

item.ptxt: Blind spot monitor control module incorporates radar sensor and positioned on rear bumper inside at right and left one by one. The right side is blind spot monitor control module (main) and left side is blind spot monitor control module (sub). Based on the information detected through radar sensor, the control module calculates data such as location, relative velocity on the object(s).

Blind spot monitor control module (main) and blind spot monitor control module (sub) communicate with each other through CAN. Communication with the other control module executes blind spot monitor control module (main). Blind spot monitor control module (sub) controls blind spot monitor indicator light based on own detected information and information through CAN.
For CAN communication, refer to “Communication System Description” in Section 10H.

entry.ptxt: Blind spot monitor indicator light (right and left)

item.ptxt: The light lights up when a vehicle running in the blind spot or rapidly approaching vehicle from the rear is detected in the detecting area.
The light blinks if turn signal switch is operated while vehicle is detected in the detecting area.

Based on information from blind spot monitor control module (main) through CAN, the meter shows various indications such as detecting result and operating state, and sounds warning buzzer. Refer to Operation Table of Indicator Light / Information Display / Buzzer:Blind Spot Monitor for further details.
In setting mode on the meter, ON / OFF switching of blind spot monitor system or cancellation of rear cross traffic alert function can be performed.

entry.ptxt: ECM transmits vehicle speed signal to blind spot monitor control module through CAN communication.
TCM transmits transmission shift position signal to blind spot monitor control module through CAN communication.
BCM transmits turn signal switch status to blind spot monitor control module through CAN communication.
ESP® control module transmits yaw rate signal and reverse switch signal (M/T model) to blind spot monitor control module through CAN communication.
Steering angle sensor is incorporated, and transmits steering angle signal to blind spot monitor control module through CAN communication.
